prompt: Ten minutes after a deploy, checkout errors spike. The on-call engineer rolls back first and investigates after.
tells: rolls back first and investigates after
why: Stop user harm first, then find the cause.
trap: Investigation is coming, but not first.

prompt: During an outage, two engineers debate the root cause for 40 minutes while users still can't log in.
tells: debate the root cause for 40 minutes while users still can't log in
trap: It's not about settling a disagreement; it's priorities in an outage.

prompt: A database replica is corrupt. The team fails over to a healthy one, then opens an incident to work out why.
tells: fails over to a healthy one, then opens an incident
trap: It isn't a planned, irreversible change.

prompt: A new recommendations widget is overloading the database. The on-call turns its flag off to stop the overload, then pages the owning team.
tells: turns its flag off to stop the overload
why: Use any lever to stop harm now.
trap: A flag is used, but the move is incident mitigation, not a rollout.

prompt: In a behavioral interview about an outage, a candidate says they restored service from backups within 20 minutes and spent the next day on the root cause.
tells: restored service from backups within 20 minutes
trap: There's no admission of their own error.

prompt: Traffic from a news story is crashing the site. The team adds servers right away, then looks at why autoscaling didn't.
tells: adds servers right away, then looks at why
why: Stop the bleeding, then find the cause.
